# 模拟卷 B

> 自编训练卷，依据课程材料题型设计；并非官方试卷。建议 100 分钟，满分 100 分。题目与参考答案分离。

时间建议：听力15分钟；改错15分钟；段落15分钟；改写10分钟；摘要15分钟；作文30分钟。

题型依据：新闻填空 → Unit 1–8；句子修改 → Sentence skills；段落 → paragraph structure / unity and coherence / supporting details；改写与摘要 → paraphrase and summary；短文 → from paragraph to essay / argumentative essays / cause and effect essays。所有题干、新闻及范文均为新编训练内容。

## 一、新闻听力填空

共 10 空，每空 2 分。听力稿为原创练习材料，不是实际新闻或官方试题。首次练习请让同伴朗读或使用设备朗读，不要先看答案册。也可换用原 Unit MP3 及其对应题目；不能用原 MP3 回答本卷新编题。

### B-L1

城市绿地项目
Local officials have approved a plan to turn an empty factory site into a [1] __________. Construction is expected to begin in March, following a [2] __________. The project will include walking paths and a small area for outdoor classes. Environmental researchers say that urban green spaces can reduce [3] __________ and provide opportunities for exercise. However, they warn that these benefits depend on [4] __________. The council has promised to publish the [5] __________ before work begins.

作答：

____________________________________________________________

### B-L2

研究技能工作坊
A university writing centre is introducing a series of workshops for new [6] __________. The sessions will focus on summarising research and [7] __________. In a recent survey, students identified paraphrasing as their [8] __________. Tutors will therefore teach them to record the central idea before changing [9] __________. They will also explain why replacing a few words is not enough to avoid plagiarism. Participants will complete a short writing task, and receive individual feedback within [10] __________.

作答：

____________________________________________________________

## 三、段落改写与续写

每题 8 分，共 16 分。关注主题、支撑、统一与连贯。

### B-P1

重写为统一、连贯的 60–90 词段落，可删去无关信息并增加必要连接。
Online courses offer flexibility. Students can watch lectures after work. The city has several old buildings. Some learners live far from the campus. Recorded lessons allow learners to review difficult points.

作答：

____________________________________________________________

### B-P2

续写主题句，完成 60–90 词段落。用两个具体理由支持观点，并写结句。
Universities should teach new students how to evaluate online information.

作答：

____________________________________________________________

## 五、Summary

用 40–60 个英文词概括下文。保留主旨和限制，不添加个人观点。10 分。

### B-S1

A writing centre tested a peer-review activity in an introductory academic writing course. Students first read a short checklist covering topic sentences, relevant support and clear connections. They then exchanged drafts and marked places where the argument was difficult to follow. Most students revised their organisation after receiving comments. Some also said that reading another person's draft helped them notice similar problems in their own writing. However, several students were uncertain about grammar and sometimes offered incorrect corrections. The tutors concluded that peer review was useful for organisation but still required teacher guidance. They recommended giving students models of constructive feedback before the next activity.

作答：

____________________________________________________________
